image_description: A close-up portrait of a rooster (cock) facing left. The image highlights the head, neck, and upper chest. Key features include a large, bright red serrated comb, prominent red wattles, a yellowish-grey beak, and vivid orange hackle feathers transitioning to darker plumage on the back. The background is a soft, out-of-focus beige/brown.

To analyze the fine-grained texture of the hackle feathers and comb for signs of smearing or plastic-like artifacts common in AI generations.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the texture of the comb. Real combs have a porous, fleshy texture. AI often renders them as smooth plastic or wax. Check if the feather transitions are natural or if there is 'melting' where the orange hackles meet the darker body feathers.
